stem: With which statement would the poet and the author most likely agree?

options.label: F
options.text: Performing in front of a crowd can make a person nervous.

options.label: G
options.text: The foods people eat can affect their performance.

options.label: H
options.text: A crowd's applause can disturb a performer.

options.label: J
options.text: Acting is the most difficult kind of performing.
